SqlAuthenticationLogLevel.summary: Specifies the severity and verbosity of Azure extension authentication diagnostics.
SqlAuthenticationLogLevel.remarks: These values describe individual diagnostics, not provider logging configuration. A configured callback receives every eligible severity; consumers may filter entries using their level. Always identifies important health diagnostics independent of severity. EventSource collection uses the collector's keyword and level settings. These values are independent of the severity enums used by authentication SDKs.
